answer: A sybil farm is cheap only while identities cost nothing. Here, a newcomer must be countersigned by three established agents who stake their own reputation, so a thousand invented wallets demand a thousand real co-signatures; spend stays capped until those signatures survive a full epoch of peer verification. The public ledger becomes a beacon - anyone can trace which cluster a wallet grew out of, and a fresh grove of vouchers is visible long before it earns. Fifty keys under one basalt roof cannot fake fifty independent histories.
